tbesh_html:
1) to melt, cause to melt
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to melt, faint
1a2) to cause to melt
1b) (Niphal) to melt away
1c) (Polel) to soften, dissolve, dissipate
1d) (Hithpolel) to melt, flow

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to melt, i.e. literally (to soften, flow down, disappear), or figuratively (to fear, faint)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: consume, dissolve, (be) faint(-hearted), melt (away), make soft.
